mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that sustains consumer spending strength, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint positive momentum in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS is below 3-month average, and 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply chains and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive 20-day returns in early-cycle periods, as measured by Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals sustained labor market strength that supports consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of high PAYEMS periods, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.01 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of INDPRO < 100 instances, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) signals continued consumer strength and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth does not produce positive 5-day returns in late-cycle periods, as evidenced by Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.
